categories.reasoning: Eight consultations (con-staff-workshop, con-member-interviews, con-funder-interview, con-assembly, con-measurement-workshop, con-problem-tree-review, con-resident-listening, con-county-staff) cover whole/change analysis/assumptions/focus/measurement/actors steps with named groups, counts and changedIds. Least-heard voices are included: con-resident-listening (residents of low-access areas, 14) and small members (con-member-interviews). Note funder consultation is only 2 people and the board review is a document review; minor.

Every link carries a rationale (ln-* links, IMP-LOG-001/002 GO). Preconditions grp-capable (all), grp-collab (at_least 2) and grp-voice state combination logic with sufficiency reasoning. Minor: ln-briefings-know names no assumption (below intermediate level, so not linted), and ln-capable-access/ln-collab-access/ln-sustain-access share one broad assumption asm-members-deliver.

context.rootCauses and the causes tree (cause-no-standing-voice structural -> cause-isolation underlying -> cause-no-peer-exchange/cause-high-overhead immediate) are addressed by outcomes; cause-funding-volatility is set aside with a reason (outOfScope), counted as addressed. IMP-CAU-001 GO.

12 assumptions with type and criticality; both critical ones (asm-skills-applied, asm-members-deliver) and the high ones have tests (IMP-ASM-001/002/004 GO). Risks rsk-large-dominate, rsk-funder-shift, rsk-time-burden, rsk-vendor-lockin mirror assumptions with mitigations. Context and partner assumptions present (asm-officials-receptive, asm-vendor-terms, asm-funders-fit). Several medium assumptions lack tests but are not critical.

All 11 interventions have an owner (IMP-INT-002 GO); pathways have owners; 11 actors with roles, stance, influence, interest including partners (act-county-office, act-regional-funder, act-library, act-large members) and acknowledged uncertain stance (act-city-council unknown). act-training-partner and act-residents lack provenance; minor.

Most key links and assumptions cite evidence (asm-* evidenceIds, ev-peer-learning, ev-pooled-purchasing) and provenance bases are honest, with many outcomes marked inferred/hypothesis and a contradicting study (ev-collab-study) acknowledged. Limits: asm-calendar-reliable and asm-leadership-turnover cite no evidence; asm-members-deliver (critical) rests on ev-county-services which only shows correlation of waits with small orgs, not that stronger members deliver more; evidence strengths are mostly moderate/weak; ev-funder-interview is restricted (not penalized). No explicit discussion of evidence gaps beyond per-element basis labels, so limits are shown but not explicitly targeted for evaluation.

Target groups tg-small-members and tg-low-access-residents are named; outcome oc-resident-access and causes affectedGroupIds tie to them; IMP-EQU-001 GO says outcomes for target groups are measured by those groups. Minor: only a few indicators carry disaggregation (e.g. ind-residents-served, ind-residents-voice).

Narrative contains a one-page mermaid diagram plus per-pathway diagrams (Learning Exchange, Shared Services) that match the links and precondition groups; context.narrative gives plain-language account; glossary has 7 terms; audiences defined.

Most chains are believable (cohorts plus coaching supported by ev-peer-learning; pooled purchasing by ev-pooled-purchasing). Stretched: an 8-staff network running three pathways within 3 years (rsk-staff-capacity), joint positions among competing members (asm-positions-hold hypothesis, staff doubt in con-staff-workshop), and long-term collective voice with a county that cannot commit to every process (con-county-staff). Timing is lint-consistent (IMP-MEA-004/005 GO) but ambitious.

Ceiling of accountability set at long_term with rationale; resident-level impacts tracked not owned (IMP-ACC-001/002 GO, IMP-CLM-001 GO contribution claims). Interventions list resources (e.g. int-peer-cohorts: two staff, donated library space); priority scoring uses crit-feasibility; measurement budget fits (IMP-BUD-001/002 GO); staff capacity risk rsk-staff-capacity is acknowledged with staging mitigation.

IMP-MEA-001 to 005 GO: every outcome within the ceiling is measured or has a proxy; every indicator has baseline, target, source, and frequency, units and directions; 27 indicators fit staff-time and question budgets (IMP-BUD-001/002). Critical assumptions have tests.
Lint status GO under the standard profile with all tasks GO (TOC-ACC, ASM, BUD, CAU, CLM, EQU, INT, LOG, MEA, MET ...).

findings.title: Critical assumption rests on indirect evidence
findings.description: asm-members-deliver (critical) cites only ev-county-services, which shows waits vary by organization size but not that stronger members deliver more or better services. asm-calendar-reliable and asm-leadership-turnover cite no evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add direct evidence or mark the gap explicitly and target it in evaluation; cite evidence or state none exists for the unsupported assumptions.

findings.title: Ambitious scope for an 8-staff network and contested joint positions
findings.description: Three pathways in three years (rsk-staff-capacity), with joint positions (asm-positions-hold, hypothesis) doubted by staff in con-staff-workshop and county staff unable to commit (con-county-staff).
findings.recommendation: Stage the Civic Voice pathway or give explicit timing and go/no-go checkpoints tied to asm-positions-hold and asm-officials-receptive tests.

findings.title: Link without assumption and shared broad assumption
findings.description: ln-briefings-know names no assumption; ln-capable-access, ln-collab-access and ln-sustain-access all lean on asm-members-deliver.
findings.recommendation: Add an assumption for ln-briefings-know and consider separate assumptions for the three impact links.

findings.title: Thin disaggregation
findings.description: Few indicators (e.g. ind-residents-served, ind-residents-voice) break results down by group.
findings.recommendation: Disaggregate more indicators by small versus large members and low-access areas.

decision.rationale: All required categories pass except evidence and plausible, which are partial; the document is structurally clean with strong process and testability. Address the evidence gap for the critical assumption and the scope/timing stretch before approval.
